features.title: Fix duplicate table row claims in document parser
acceptance: Table rows starting with `|` no longer generate duplicate claims
Line-by-line claim extraction skips table rows

features.title: Extract per-row table claims so table cell values feed contradiction detection
acceptance: Each table data row produces exactly one claim with 'Table row:' text
Table claim metadata includes table_header and row_data
Numeric values inside table cells (e.g. 1.3B vs 4.4B) are detected as contradictions
No duplicate claims across document content
